The <b>Needle</b> is the bladed weapon wielded by [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]. It is used to perform basic attacks, as well as certain [[Silk Skills]] and [[Abilities (Silksong)|Abilities]]. The Needle can be upgraded by [[Pinmaster Plinney]] up to four times, adding additional [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)|damage]].

== Background ==
The Needle is the signature weapon of [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], the princess of [[Hallownest]]. It is a long sewing tool balanced for combat, forged from the strongest steel by [[Bees|the members]] of [[the Hive]], engraved with hivesteel bandings, and given as gift to the princess.<ref>Hornet and [[Pinmaster Plinney]] dialogue:<br>Hornet: <i>"The blade was a gift, given by a noble tribe of my homeland. They forged the strongest steel, though it was rarely seen beyond their hive."</i></ref><ref>Hivesteel Needle description: <i>"Long sewing tool, uniquely balanced for combat. The highly refined blade reveals its hivesteel banding."</i></ref>

By the time Hornet enters [[Pharloom]], the Needle's blade has been greatly dulled by time and use.<ref>Needle description: <i>Long sewing tool, uniquely balanced for combat. The blade is marked by time and use.</i></ref><ref>Hornet and [[Pinmaster Plinney]] dialogue:<br>Hornet: <i>"This is fine service, pinmaster. It has been a long age since I have seen my needle such. I had not remembered the finesse of its forging."</i></ref>

== Crests ==
Each [[Crest]] provides a unique set of Needle attacks. The basic attacks differ in speed and range, while [[Needle Strike]]s differ in range, damage and the number of hits per attack.

Additionally, some crests provide situational [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)|damage]] bonuses:

* Evolved [[Hunter Crest]], by 30% after landing 6 hits. Hunter Crest's second evolution increases the damage bonus to 50% after another 6 hits. The damage bonuses persist until Hornet takes damage.
* [[Beast Crest]], by 25% in fury mode after [[Bind]]ing. Fury mode by default lasts 4.7 seconds, and can be increased by dealing damage or decreased by taking damage.
* [[Wanderer Crest]], by 3x damage via a 2% chance (2.2% with the [[Magnetite Dice]]) of random critical hits while Bind is ready.

== Needle-bouncing ==
While in the air, downward slashes can be performed on enemies, spikes and certain objects in order to bounce. This move is known as "Needle-bouncing", "pogo-jumping", or simply "pogo-ing". Successfully bouncing refreshes Hornet's mid-air abilities.

Like with other attacks, each crest provides a unique downward slash, requiring different positioning relative to the bounce target.

* [[Hunter Crest]]: Hornet does a long dash strike diagonally downwards.
* [[Reaper Crest]]: Hornet cuts down in a wide half-circle, moving diagonally downwards a short distance in the facing direction.
* [[Wanderer Crest]]: Hornet performs a quick, wide slash directly beneath herself, lacking sideways movement on a miss or delay before bouncing on a hit. This is similar to [[The Knight|the Knight's]] slashes from the first game.
* [[Beast Crest]]: Hornet pounces forward and spins like a sawblade after a slight delay, with a movement arc similar to a dash that curves downwards and can be adjusted slightly. On a successful hit, Hornet bounces up unless she is too far below the target.
* [[Witch Crest]]: Hornet whips her Needle downwards with a small angular offset. On hit, she briefly becomes intangible. This attack strikes twice on hit; however, this does not generate more Silk. The damage is split between the two hits, the first dealing slightly more, totalling 1 more damage than normal.
* [[Architect Crest]]: Hornet dives diagonally downwards, drilling in the same direction. Holding the attack button makes Hornet pause to charge, extending the spin time, dive distance, and the number of hits it deals. With a full charge, it deals double damage and strikes twice as many times. The damage is spread roughly evenly across hits.
* [[Shaman Crest]]: Hornet fires an energy wave downward. This causes Hornet to move up slightly even if it does not hit a target, although hitting a target moves her further.

== Tools ==
Some [[Tools]] affect various aspects of the Needle:

* [[Weighted Belt]] lessens knockback when striking an enemy.
* [[Longclaw]] increases the Needle's range by 27%.
* [[Flea Brew]] temporarily increases the Needle's attack speed by 50%.
* [[Flintslate]] temporarily increases the Needle's damage by 50% and inflicts burn upon three consecutive hits.
** When combined with [[Pollip Pouch]], the Needle inflicts poison on every hit, but the damage bonus is reduced and burn is no longer applied.
* [[Barbed Bracelet]] increases the Needle's damage by 25% at the cost of doubling the damage Hornet receives.
